scope.quote: In the `function processSwapFee`, fees are computed with the expression

However, there is no check to ensure that the product _tokenAmount * swapFeeBp is at least 10,000 before dividing; this results in a zero-fee swap, even though a non-zero basis-point fee was intended.
Users can repeatedly swap “dust” amounts below the threshold without paying fees, depriving the protocol (or fee recipient) of expected income.
